QC Datasets & Directory Organization

This document details the mass spectrometry metabolomics data transfers (El-MAVEN / LC-MS), reference hand-calculated batch corrections, automated pipeline outputs, and protocol documentation stored under data/"QC Batch Correction".

Files are shared by Qiushi Sun via Microsoft OneDrive folders and downloaded to timestamped subdirectories (YYYYMMDD).

MS OneDrive Source Folders (Private)

  • 20231127: Founder Plasma (RC2 benchmark)
  • 20251112: 1_EM_outputs_for_Batch_Correction
  • 20261020: DO_Plasma_tar_untar_metab_For_Batch_Correction

Reference Protocol Documents

  • Batch_Correction_Procedure_RC2_Project.pdf / Batch_Correction_Procedure_RC2_Project.pptx: Standard operating procedure (SOP) by Qiushi describing manual plate-by-plate QC pool batch correction. Details:
    • Plate QC mean vs. global compound QC mean calculation.
    • Correction factor (CFb,p,c\text{CF}_{b,p,c}) assignment per compound and plate.
    • Handling of missing metabolites in plate QC runs (using plate average CF).
    • Outlier exclusion (dropping the first QC sample on plate for RP_Pos mode).

Folder Breakdown and Changing Naming Conventions

Data transfers are organized by timestamped directories (YYYYMMDD), tracking different cohorts, tissues, and evolving file and directory naming conventions over time.

1. 20231127/ — Founder Plasma (Validation Benchmark)

Initial study transfer containing both raw mass spec exports and manual hand-calculated batch-corrected workbooks used to validate metabr automation against human curation.

  • Cohort & Tissue: Founder mice, Plasma
  • Modes: HC_Neg (Hydrophilic Interaction Chromatography, negative mode) and RP_Pos (Reverse Phase, positive mode)
  • Subdirectories: Contains both Raw and Corrected hand data, plus Automated pipeline outputs:
    • #Founder_Plasma_Raw_Data/: Raw peak-area CSV exports from El-MAVEN.
      • Pattern: Founder_Plasma_All_Timepoints_{Mode}_{targeted/untargeted}_Raw.csv
      • Examples:
        • Founder_Plasma_All_Timepoints_HC_Neg_targeted_Raw.csv
        • Founder_Plasma_All_Timepoints_RP_Pos_targeted_Raw.csv
        • Founder_Plasma_All_Timepoints_HC_Neg_untargeted_Raw.csv
        • Founder_Plasma_All_Timepoints_RP_Pos_untargeted_Raw.csv
    • #Founder_Plasma_Batch_Corrected_Data/: Reference hand-calculated multi-sheet Excel files.
      • Pattern: Founder_Plasma_{Mode}_{Targeted/untargeted_All}_Batch_Corrected_Data.xlsx
    • Automated/: Pipeline outputs generated via qc_steps() and write_metab().
      • Pattern: Standardized {Mode}_{Targeted/Untargeted}.csv
      • Files: HC_Neg_Targeted.csv, HC_Neg_Untargeted.csv, RP_Pos_Targeted.csv, RP_Pos_Untargeted.csv

2. 20251112/ — DO Livers (November 2025 Data Drop)

Second transfer representing Diversity Outbred (DO) liver tissues. This batch only has Raw data inputs, relying entirely on automated batch correction without manual Excel curation.

  • Cohort & Tissue: Diversity Outbred (DO) mice, Liver
  • Modes: HC_Neg and RP_Pos (Targeted and Untargeted)
  • Subdirectories:
    • 2025_Nov_Raw/: Raw El-MAVEN CSV exports.
      • Naming variations:
        • DO_Livers_HC_Neg_Targeted(in).csv (includes (in) input suffix)
        • DO_Livers_RP_Pos_Targeted.csv
        • DO_Livers_{Mode}_Untargeted_min1000.csv (includes min1000 minimum peak area threshold)
    • 2025_Nov_Automated/: Pipeline outputs generated via qc_steps() and write_metab().
      • Pattern: Standardized {Mode}_{Targeted/Untargeted}.csv
      • Files: HC_Neg_Targeted.csv, RP_Pos_Targeted.csv, HC_Neg_Untargeted.csv, RP_Pos_Untargeted.csv

3. 20261020/ — DO Plasma (Current Batch)

Latest data drop containing Diversity Outbred (DO) plasma samples. This folder only has files provided for batch correction (Corrected).

  • Cohort & Tissue: Diversity Outbred (DO) mice, Plasma
  • Modes: HC_Neg and RP_Pos (Targeted and Untargeted)
  • Subdirectories:
    • DO_Plasma_tar_untar_metab_For_Batch_Correction/: Incoming CSV files prepared for batch correction.
      • Pattern: Standardized DO_Plasma_{Mode}_{Targeted/Untargeted}_For_Batch_Correction.csv
      • Files:
        • DO_Plasma_HC_Neg_Targeted_For_Batch_Correction.csv
        • DO_Plasma_HC_Neg_Untargeted_For_Batch_Correction.csv
        • DO_Plasma_RP_Pos_Targeted_For_Batch_Correction.csv
        • DO_Plasma_RP_Pos_Untargeted_For_Batch_Correction.csv
    • Automated/: Target directory for pipeline outputs when processed.

Summary of Conventions

Date Directory Cohort Tissue Data Available Subfolders File Naming Pattern
20231127/ Founder Plasma Raw & Corrected (Hand) + Automated #Founder_Plasma_Raw_Data/, #Founder_Plasma_Batch_Corrected_Data/, Automated/ Founder_Plasma_All_Timepoints_{Mode}_{type}_Raw.csv
20251112/ DO Liver Raw only + Automated 2025_Nov_Raw/, 2025_Nov_Automated/ DO_Livers_{Mode}_{Type}[_(in)/_min1000].csv
20261020/ DO Plasma Corrected (For Batch Correction) DO_Plasma_tar_untar_metab_For_Batch_Correction/, Automated/ DO_Plasma_{Mode}_{Type}_For_Batch_Correction.csv
